A few useful answers

How do I place a block?

Select a block, tap a space, then tap Place. The chevrons move the preview; the colored arrow shows gravity. The block’s arrow determines the direction of the entire shift. Full rows and columns clear before pieces settle. Connected fragments move together until a clear splits them.

Can I play without internet or ads?

Yes. Normal puzzle play, retries and new starts work offline. Version 1.0.0 has advertising disabled. In version 1.0.1, a banner can appear in a separate area above non-tutorial gameplay when there is enough space. Short and large-text layouts omit it. Rewarded videos are not offered in this release. Starting, retrying and continuing never require an ad. Ad availability does not affect normal play.

Where is my saved progress?

Progress is stored on your device, with separate saved attempts for each mode. Keep the app installed when updating, including the update from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1: your saved progress, earned Sparks and unlocked looks carry over without a reset or reinstall. There is no Shift Square account or cloud-sync service. Removing the app or resetting local progress can remove your saves. To reset, use Settings → Reset local progress and confirm.

How does Daily Shift work?

Daily Shift has 600 objective stages, made by mirroring Challenge boards and directions. Solve your current stage to unlock the next one on the following local day. An unfinished stage remains available, and the same day’s puzzle stays pinned. After all 600 stages, the Climb is complete; Daily Score Practice remains available as a separate finite library of 1,095 boards. Practice and shared stages do not advance the Climb or award Sparks. Older saved Daily attempts keep their original 12-move rules.

Does Classic get harder?

Yes. New Classic runs are endless: each level adds another pressure tray before the next small-piece tray. Later levels combine more demanding piece distributions and shapes, and the number of pressure trays keeps growing after every shape has appeared. Small-piece trays are part of the normal rules; they do not clear the board for you. A Classic game saved in an older version keeps its original dealing rules so an update does not change your current run. Finish it or start a new run to use the new progression.

What happens to my Sparks and rewards?

Versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 do not offer rewarded videos. You still earn Sparks through normal eligible play. Previously earned rewards remain in your save, and existing verified Plus access retains its included result bonuses. No new Plus purchase is offered in this release. If recovery of an earned reward was interrupted, reopen the app or use Settings → Retry saved reward recovery when shown.

How do I share a finished run?

In version 1.0.1, tap Share score on the result screen. The card includes the final board, score and run details. Choose an app from the system share sheet, or close it to return to your result. Sharing does not spend Sparks or change your saved progress.

How do I change ad privacy choices?

In version 1.0.1, Settings → Ad privacy choices appears when the consent service requires that option. Required regional privacy choices are handled before banner requests. Privacy or connection problems do not prevent normal puzzle play.

How do I change motion, sound or controls?

Open Settings for sound, haptics, reduced motion, direction patterns, high-contrast contours and placement controls. System Reduce Motion is respected.

Reporting an issue

Include your iPhone model, iOS version, app version, the game mode and stage or date, and what happened. Settings → Export diagnostic summary produces a short version-and-totals summary without personal identifiers or full saved boards. Sharing it is your choice.

Please do not send passwords, payment information or other sensitive information. We use your email and report to respond and investigate. Read our privacy policy for details.
